reconstruction.scope: Individual surviving Utrecht Domkerk with broad north/south transept, narrow eastern polygonal choir, gray slate cross roof, warm mixed brick/stone Gothic facades, tall pointed glazing, layered lower ambulatory/chapels, flying buttresses and pinnacles. Separate western Dom Tower across the open square: square lower stages, open tall belfry and octagonal lantern/crown, gray pointed cap and finial; real ground passage retained. South U-shaped low cloister with genuinely open garden arcades. No vanished connecting nave. Shared materials and standard-terrain footings. Exact carved sculpture, inscriptions, bells/internal staircases, temporary west-front trompe-l’oeil artwork, garden trees/fountain, interiors and certified walking excluded.
